deferred.title: Absolute revision_index shifts when a revision is prepended
deferred.problem: History is newest-first and each save or rollback prepends an entry, so an index from one listing can map to a different revision by the time rollback is called or the next page is fetched.
deferred.preexisting: rollback_to_version already addressed history by positional index and prepended entries before pagination.
